title: Flow lookup
intro: For an incident: the raw flows the agents keep for a week, by seat, address, owner, port and time. Every search needs a reason and goes to the audit log; Floorbit keeps no result.
reasonHint: Goes to the audit log, e.g. "P2P flood on the D uplink, incident 42".
nameSomething: Name a seat, an address, an owner or a port: the lookup never lists the whole hall.
stopped: The agent stopped reading after 10 seconds: older flows may be missing. Pick a shorter time.
